sections.title: Taxes and charges in India: the full list

rows.label: Corporate income tax [national]
rows.value: 25% or 30% for domestic companies, 22% or 15% under the optional regimes, 35% for foreign companies, plus surcharge and 4% cess; MAT of 14% on book profit. Paid by companies resident in India on worldwide income, and foreign companies on income from India. Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 200, 201 and 206; Finance Act, 2026 First Schedule. In force from 2026-04-01.

source.title: Finance Act, 2026 (No. 4 of 2026), section 3(1) and First Schedule Part I-B Paragraph E and Part III Paragraph E; Income-tax Act, 2025 (No. 30 of 2025), sections 200 and 201

rows.label: Tax on branch profits and distributed profits [national]
rows.value: none; dividends are taxed in the shareholder's hands, with 10% withheld for residents and 20% for non-residents. Paid by no one (shareholders pay income tax on dividends). Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 7(2) and 393. In force from 2026-04-01.

source.title: Income-tax Act, 2025 (No. 30 of 2025), sections 7(2), 9(4) and 393(1) Table Sl.7; Finance Act, 2026 First Schedule Part I-B Paragraph E

rows.label: Self-employed contributions [national]
rows.value: none compulsory; government welfare schemes for unorganised workers. Paid by no one. Code on Social Security, 2020 sections 2(75), 2(86) and 109. In force from 2025-11-21.

source.title: Code on Social Security, 2020 (No. 36 of 2020), sections 2(26), 2(75), 2(85), 2(86), 15(1)(d) and 109 (in force from 21 November 2025)

rows.label: Contractor payments: tax deducted at source [national]
rows.value: 1% or 2% on contract work, 10% on professional fees (2% on technical fees). Paid by contractors and professionals (deducted by the payer). Income-tax Act, 2025 section 393(1) Table Sl.6. In force from 2026-04-01.

source.title: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 393(1) Table Sl.6(i) (formerly section 194C of the 1961 Act)

rows.label: Presumptive taxation of small businesses and professionals [national]
rows.value: deemed profit of 6% or 8% of business turnover up to ₹2 crore (₹3 crore with little cash), 50% of professional receipts up to ₹50 lakh (₹75 lakh). Paid by resident individuals, HUFs and firms that choose it. Income-tax Act, 2025 section 58. In force from 2026-04-01.

source.title: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 58(2) Table Sl.1, 58(4), 58(7) and 58(11)(a) (formerly section 44AD); Finance Act, 2026 section 40

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: normal slab rates on salary for services rendered in India, withheld by the employer; resident after 182 days in the tax year. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 6, 9(3), 392 and Schedule IV. In force from 2026-04-01.

source.title: Income-tax Act, 2025, sections 5, 9(3), 156(1), 159 and 392(1); Finance Act, 2026 First Schedule Part I-B and Part III

rows.label: Property tax (municipal) [local]
rows.value: rates and base set by each municipality; states notify floor rates. Paid by owners of buildings and land in municipal areas. state municipal laws.

source.title: Press Information Bureau: Finance Commission holds meeting with MoHUA on Property Taxation by ULBs (17 July 2020)

rows.label: Stamp duty and registration on property transfers [state]
rows.value: 4% to 7% of the market value in the states read (Maharashtra, Delhi, West Bengal), set by each state; registration fee 1% in Delhi. Paid by the buyer. state stamp laws; Registration Act, 1908.

source.title: Department of Revenue, Government of NCT of Delhi: Property Registration; Maharashtra Stamp Act (article-wise, 22 July 2026); West Bengal Directorate of Registration and Stamp Revenue: Stamp Duties and Fees

rows.label: Capital gains tax for individuals [national]
rows.value: 12.5% on long-term gains (above ₹1.25 lakh a year on listed equity with STT), 20% on short-term gains on listed equity with STT. Paid by individuals and HUFs (and other assessees). Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 196 to 198.
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-gains

source.title: Income-tax Act, 2025 (No. 30 of 2025), sections 2(101), 196, 197 and 198

rows.label: Withholding on dividends, interest and royalties (tax deducted at source) [national]
rows.value: residents: 10% on interest and dividends above the thresholds; non-residents: 20% on dividends, interest, royalties and technical fees, 30% on other income, before treaty relief. Paid by the payee (deducted by the payer). Income-tax Act, 2025 section 393; Finance Act, 2026 First Schedule Part II.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: investment-income

source.title: Finance Act, 2026 (No. 4 of 2026), First Schedule Part II (rates for deduction of tax at source in certain cases)

rows.label: Tax on rental income and pension income [national]
rows.value: rent: annual value less a 30% standard deduction and loan interest, at slab rates; pensions taxed as salary. Paid by landlords and pensioners. Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 16, 20 and 22.
rows.note: Checklist item A7; detailed table: rental-income

source.title: Income-tax Act, 2025 (No. 30 of 2025), sections 16, 20 and 22

rows.label: GST structure: CGST, SGST or UTGST, and IGST [national and state]
rows.value: central plus State (or Union territory) GST within a State, integrated GST on inter-State supplies and imports, at 5%, 18% or 40% in all (and special rates on precious metals and stones); compensation cess withdrawn from 1 February 2026. Paid by consumers (collected by registered suppliers). Constitution articles 246A and 269A; Notification No. 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) as amended.
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: gst-structure

source.title: GST Council monthly newsletter, December 2025: Notification No. 19/2025-Central Tax (Rate) and No. 03/2025-Compensation Cess (Rate)

rows.label: State sales tax (VAT) on petrol and diesel [state]
rows.value: from 1% (Andaman and Nicobar Islands) to 35.2% (petrol, Telangana), often with a minimum per litre and cesses. Paid by fuel buyers (collected by the oil companies and dealers). State VAT and sales tax laws.
rows.note: Checklist item D2; detailed table: state-sales-tax

rows.label: Central excise duty on motor fuels [national]
rows.value: petrol ₹11.90 a litre in all (basic duty, special additional duty, agriculture cess, road cess), diesel ₹7.80 a litre. Paid by fuel manufacturers and importers (passed on in the price). Central Excise Act, 1944 and the Finance Acts.

rows.label: Securities transaction tax (a financial transaction tax) [national]
rows.value: 0.15% on options and 0.05% on futures from the Finance Act, 2026. Paid by parties to trades on recognised stock exchanges. Finance (No. 2) Act, 2004 section 98, as amended by the Finance Act, 2026 section 159.
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: financial-transaction-tax

source.title: Finance Act, 2026 (No. 4 of 2026), section 159 (amendment of section 98 of the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2004)

rows.label: Wealth tax [national]
rows.value: none: abolished from assessment year 2016-17. Paid by no one. Budget 2015-16 speech of the Minister of Finance.

rows.label: Estate duty and inheritance tax [national]
rows.value: none: estate duty abolished for deaths on or after 16 March 1985. Paid by no one. Budget 1985-86 speech of the Minister of Finance.

source.title: Budget 1985-86: Speech of the Minister of Finance, paragraph 88

rows.label: Gift tax: gifts taxed as the recipient's income [national]
rows.value: no separate gift tax; gifts above ₹50,000 a year from non-relatives are taxed as income at slab rates. Paid by the recipient. Income-tax Act, 2025 section 92(2)(m) and (3).

rows.label: Customs duty, Social Welfare Surcharge, import IGST and baggage allowances [national]
rows.value: basic customs duty by tariff heading, 10% Social Welfare Surcharge on it, integrated GST; baggage allowance ₹75,000 (₹25,000 for foreign tourists). Paid by importers and travellers. Customs Act, 1962; Customs Tariff Act, 1975; Baggage Rules, 2026.

rows.value: fixed amounts (e.g. ₹100 on an affidavit) or a share of the value (5% on a mortgage with possession); set by each State. Paid by parties to the document. Karnataka Stamp Act, 1957.

rows.label: New residents: not ordinarily resident status [national]
rows.value: foreign income untaxed (unless from a business controlled or profession set up in India) for residents who were non-resident in 9 of the 10 previous years or in India 729 days or less in the previous 7 years. Paid by returning citizens and new residents. Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 5(1)(c) and 6(13).

rows.value: 25% or 30% for domestic companies, 22% or 15% under the optional regimes, 35% for foreign companies, plus surcharge and 4% cess; MAT of 14% on book profit. Paid by companies resident in India on worldwide income, and foreign companies on income from India. Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 200, 201 and 206; Finance Act, 2026 First Schedule. In force from 2026-04-01.

rows.value: rent: annual value less a 30% standard deduction and loan interest, at slab rates; pensions taxed as salary. Paid by landlords and pensioners. Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 16, 20 and 22.
